mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.5%, it triggers a monetary policy tightening expectation that depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% (y/y).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing recovery regime (HOUST > 1300 thousand units), rising home construction activity signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1300.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 700,000 million dollars, it indicates strong consumer spending that boosts corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 700000.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a further decline in unemployment signals tight labor market conditions that may lead to wage inflation and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-interest-rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), a further increase in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0.
